subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Robin watched as the smoke _________ steadily from the chimney.
solution: The correct answer is **Option 2** i.e. **rose.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The sentence describes the movement of smoke from the chimney. • The word **"rose" (उठना)** means to move upward, which fits the context of smoke moving up from the chimney. • The words **"hung," "left,"** and **"went"** do not accurately describe the upward movement of smoke. • Understanding the meaning of **"rose"** in the context of the sentence helps to clarify that the smoke is moving upward from the chimney. Therefore, the **correct answer** is- **rose.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Hung (लटकना)** means to be suspended from above with the lower part dangling. • **Left (छोड़ना)** means to go away from. • **Went (गया)** is the past tense of "go" and means to move from one place to another. 43:Tfe9,
